_doc: Terminology and translation rules checked by test/core/i18n_glossary_test.dart.
untranslatable: keys whose text is the same in every language (product and method names, symbols, formulas, codes); the test requires the English text in pt, es and every pack.
sameAsEnglishAllowed: keys a pack may leave in English (acronyms of methods and materials, file names, formats).
provisionalEnglish: keys whose English text changed and whose packs show the English text until the next translation pass; remove a key once its packs are translated.
perLanguageAllowed: keys that stay as in English in one language on purpose.
maxSameAsEnglish: the Latin-script packs, where many words are the same as in English, may not have more keys equal to English than this (lower it when translations improve).
terms: one name per concept and language: a string of that language must not use an avoided word (whole word, ignoring case); 'use' says the chosen term.
